arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The path to a directory containing a .sln/.slnx file  and/or a package.json, a specific .sln/.slnx file, a specific .csproj file, or a specific package.json. Defaults to the current working directory

options.name: --cache-file-path
options.description: Overrides the file path where analysis data is cached.  Defaults to the  "<workingdirectory>/.packageguard/cache.bin"

options.name: --config-path
options.description: The path to the configuration file. Defaults to  hierarchical discovery of packageguard.config.json or .packageguard/config.json  files starting from the solution directory.

options.name: --force-restore
options.description: Force restoring the NuGet dependencies, even if the  lockfile is up-to-date

options.name: --github-api-key
options.description: GitHub API key to use for fetching package licenses. If  not specified, you may run into GitHub's rate limiting issues.

options.name: --ignore-violations
options.description: Don't fail the analysis if any violations are found.  Defaults to false.

options.name: --npm
options.description: Explicitly specify the package manager to use (npm, yarn,  pnpm). If not specified, it will detect it automatically.

options.name: --npm-exe-path
options.description: The path to the npm, yarn or pnpm executable. If not  specified, the system PATH is used.

options.name: --nuget
options.description: Explicitly enable or disable scanning for .csproj, .sln or .slnx files

options.name: --refresh-risk-cache
options.description: Force --report-risk to rebuild risk-related package data  instead of reusing cached risk entries.

options.name: --report-risk
options.description: Show a colored risk summary in the console and generate  detailed HTML/SARIF risk reports. Optionally provide a directory or file path.  Directories receive generated file names; explicit filenames are used directly  and may overwrite prior files.

options.name: --restore-interactive
options.description: Allow enabling or disabling an interactive mode of  "dotnet restore". Defaults to true

options.name: --risk-cache-max-age-hours
options.description: Maximum age in hours for cached risk-related package data  before --report-risk refreshes it.

options.name: --skip-restore
options.description: Prevent the restore operation from running, even if the  lock file is missing or out-of-date

options.name: --use-caching
options.description: Maintains a cache of the package information to speed up  future analysis.
